market_wrap.text: Nifty rose 0.25% to about 25,885 and the Sensex about 390 points in a choppy, range-bound session. IT (Nifty IT +3.7%) and realty led, while FMCG fell about 1% after the Supreme Court called for separate warning labels for each nutrient of concern on food packaging.

reasons.reason: KFintech jumped as much as 7% to about ₹1,000 on interest around the Mahanadi Coalfields IPO, for which it is the registrar; allotment finished on Wednesday and refunds and share credits began today. The move came despite a recent ₹10 lakh SEBI penalty over share-processing lapses.

Silver bounced back from near its 52-week low: MCX December silver was up about 3.4% to roughly ₹1.47 lakh/kg in the afternoon on value buying and steady US Treasury yields, ahead of the US Thanksgiving holiday.

No company news found today; its last exchange filings were from mid-November. Metals recovered after Wednesday's fall (Nifty Metal +1.2%) as precious metals rebounded, and the stock traded between about ₹406 and ₹414.

news.headline: KFintech handles Mahanadi Coalfields IPO; allotment completed
news.summary: Refunds and demat credits for the Mahanadi Coalfields IPO, where KFintech is registrar, began on 26 November. The company was recently fined ₹10 lakh by SEBI over share-processing issues.
